Decision support — the authoritative source is the current Carelon Provider Manual and the Authorization Grid; more specifics per level of care live in the manual's Authorization Requirements section.

requestTypes.label: Concurrent — Non-Urgent
requestTypes.timing: Prior to the authorization term (before the last authorized day)

requestTypes.label: Retrospective
requestTypes.determination: Reverts to Prospective — within 30 calendar days

concurrentReview.rule: Request continued authorization before the last authorized day of service; the continued-stay/concurrent request carries supporting clinical information.
concurrentReview.example: For an initial authorization span of March 1–March 4, submit the continued-stay request by March 4 (the last authorized day).
